fix: pctid-based novelty metric (Wave 166 P2): twilight-zone threshold <30% pctid at loose -e 100; replaces e-value-based novelty metric that saturates for short fragments against long DB sequences
db: canonical Pfam-A (63,811,783 seed sequences; sample mean_len 178.5 aa; built in Wave 164)
queries: LineageFlow N=5 sanity (baseline + framework) from Wave 165b P3
mmseqs_cmd_template: mmseqs easy-search QUERY FASTA pfam_a_targetDB OUT.m8 TMP/ -s 7.5 -e 100 --threads 4
novel_metric_definition: novel(seq) = (no hit at any threshold) OR (max pctid at -e 100 < threshold)

delta.interpretation: fix restores discrimination: baseline 3/5 novel vs framework 0/5 novel at twilight-zone threshold (opposite of saturation finding). Framework sequences concentrate in known families (zinc-finger / DNA-binding per Wave 165 P7).

sensitivity_to_pctid_threshold.10_pct: baseline likely 0/5 novel; framework 0/5 novel (all framework hits >50%)
sensitivity_to_pctid_threshold.50_pct: baseline 3/5 novel; framework 0/5 novel (no framework pctid <50%)
sensitivity_to_pctid_threshold.60_pct: baseline 3/5 novel; framework 1/5 novel (1 framework seed <57.1%)

wave_purpose: Wave 166 P2 implements the recommended fix from P1 diagnosis (Option A: percent-identity-based novelty metric).
